verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers machine creation, SSH access, templates, pricing, and API/CLI docs, but nothing describes a real-time GPU availability dashboard or API showing stock by type/region before provisioning. The only capacity-related note is that high-end GPUs like H100 require approval requests (paperspace-docs-17), which implies scarcity but gives no visibility mechanism — community comments describe frustration with SSH/console access but not stockouts or availability info.
